hook.text: A vegan shares an animal rights article. A libertarian shares a tax meme. Both are signaling identity.

buildup.text: Sharing isn't about information transfer. It's about tribal membership. 'I belong to this group.'

discovery.text: Researchers found people share political news even when they haven't read it. The headline is enough.

twist.text: This means misinformation spreads via identity. Correcting facts doesn't work when sharing is tribal.

climax.text: Platforms amplify identity content because it generates fierce engagement—likes from allies, fights from foes.

punchline.text: You share what you are, not what you know.

quiz.question: Why do people often share political news without reading it?
